Keep the whole gate geometry, nested second doorway, stone drum bases, grey-tile outlines, roof profile, short sidewalls, every contour position, portrait canvas, empty plaques unchanged. No color or grayscale. ALL surfaces inside and outside have pure uniform opaque WHITE #FFFFFF, only the fine contour ink is black. No solid fills, shadows, hatching, gradient, paper grain, halo, checkerboard, text. The silhouette and details must not move or change. Do not substitute another gate.
